  • Reuseum Soldering Workshop

    Reuseum Soldering Workshop

    November 7, 2026  1:00 PM - 2:30 PM
    3145 W Chinden Blvd, Garden City, ID 83714, USA

    Workshop Cost: $40

    Age Range: Ages 12+

    Workshop Duration: 1:00PM to 2:30PM

    The Reuseum Educational is hosting a Soldering Workshop where participants will learn the basics and do's and dont's of soldering! Along with the instruction, each participant will receive a soldering iron kit (iron, solder, desolderer, and sponge) that they will keep upon completion of the workshop.

    The workshop is $40 and can be either paid for over the phone, (208) 375-7507, or at the Reuseum store prier to the day of the workshop in order to guarantee your spot in the class. Please note that upon paying for the workshop a receipt will be provided. Don’t forget to bring it in as proof of purchase.

    Please understand that we have limited slots available for the workshop. We will inform you in a follow up email whether their is enough slots available.  

    Follow the link below to sign up via the form at the bottom of the page.

    https://www.reuseum.com/reuseum-soldering-workshop/

  • Saturday Family Fun Workshop

    Saturday Family Fun Workshop

    November 14, 2026  10:30 AM - 12:00 PM

    The Saturday Family Fun Workshop is a monthly event that offers a FREE STEM-related activity that is fun for both children and parent! Take part in hands-on projects from Bristlebots to magnetic slime, from styrofoam boats to simple circuits.

    The workshop begins the second Saturday of each month and goes from 10:30AM to 12PM. The workshop is free for families, and monetary donations are appreciated. We look forward to having you there!

    If you would like to participate, please sign up through the following link on our website and to learn more! 

    https://www.reuseum.com/explore-curriculum/saturday-family-fun-workshop/
